Getting Started → Introduction

Welcome to Phantom Traders

Phantom Traders is an institutional-grade portfolio intelligence platform for independent traders. This documentation covers everything from setup to advanced API usage.

New here? Start with the Quick Start guide — you'll have a live portfolio in under 5 minutes.

What Phantom Traders Does

At its core, Phantom Traders gives you:

  • Real-time portfolio tracking — live prices, P&L, and performance across all holdings
  • AI risk intelligence — dynamic risk score from 6 quantitative metrics
  • Smart alerts — 6 alert types delivered via in-app, email, or SMS
  • Stock screener — filter + AI recommendations based on your portfolio gaps
  • Tax harvesting — automatic loss opportunity identification
  • Trade journal — block calendar with stocks and options support

System Requirements

Phantom Traders runs entirely in your browser — no download, no install.

Firefox88+Latest ✓

Getting Started → Quick Start

Quick Start Guide

Get your portfolio live in under 5 minutes. Follow these steps:

1

Create your account

Click Sign Up, enter your email and password. No credit card needed for the free plan.

2

Choose your trader type

The onboarding wizard asks 5 quick questions to personalise your risk settings and AI insights.

3

Add your first holdings

Enter each ticker, the number of shares, and your average cost basis. Prices fetch automatically.

4

Set your first alert

Click Alerts in the sidebar → New Alert → pick a ticker and a price target. Choose your notification channel.

5

Review your risk score

Your risk score and AI insight will compute automatically once your holdings are entered. Click the card to open the full analytics panel.

Tip: Use the portfolio size switcher (S·10 / M·25 / L·50) on the dashboard to see how different portfolio sizes affect your risk score and metrics.
Getting Started → Account Setup

Account Setup

Profile Settings

Access your profile by clicking your name in the bottom-left sidebar. From here you can update:

  • Full name, email, phone number
  • Timezone and currency display preference
  • Plan badge and renewal date
  • Notification preferences (4 toggles)
  • Connected brokerage accounts
  • Two-factor authentication

Core Features → Portfolio Tracking

Portfolio Tracking

Adding Holdings

Click + Add Holding in the dashboard header. Enter:

  • Ticker symbol — e.g. AAPL, NVDA, BRK-B
  • Shares — total number of shares held
  • Average cost — your average cost per share (not total cost)

The market price, day change, and all calculations populate automatically once the holding is saved.

Price Refresh

Prices auto-refresh every 30 seconds. The status badge in the holdings header shows:

  • ● Live — real-time feed active (Pro Trader/Elite)
  • ◎ Delayed — 15-minute delayed prices (Free)
  • ◌ Loading — fetch in progress
Free tier note: Yahoo Finance prices are used on the free plan and are subject to a 15-minute delay. Upgrade to Pro for Polygon.io real-time data.

Calculated Columns

ColumnFormula
Mkt ValueShares × Current Price
Gain / Loss $(Current Price − Avg Cost) × Shares
Total Return %(Current Price − Avg Cost) / Avg Cost × 100
Day Chg $(Current Price − Prev Close) × Shares
WeightPosition Market Value / Total Portfolio Value × 100
Core Features → Risk Score

Risk Score

The risk score is a 0–100 number computed from 6 quantitative metrics derived from your actual holdings. It recalculates on every price tick and every portfolio change.

Score Calculation

MetricDirectionMax Impact
HHI Concentration↑ Increases risk+40 pts
Weighted Portfolio Beta↑ Increases risk+20 pts
Losing Position Weight↑ Increases risk+15 pts
Sector Diversity↓ Reduces risk−20 pts
Position Count↓ Reduces risk−10 pts
Win Rate↓ Reduces risk±5 pts

Risk Labels

Score RangeLabelMeaning
0 – 31◉ Low RiskWell-diversified, defensive, low beta
32 – 47◉ Mod-LowGood balance, minor concentration
48 – 64⊛ ModerateAverage market risk, typical portfolio
65 – 79⊛ Mod-HighElevated concentration or high-beta sectors
80 – 100⚠ High RiskHeavy concentration, very high beta, losses
Tip: Click the Risk Score card on your dashboard to jump directly to the Analytics panel for the full breakdown.
Core Features → Price Alerts

Price Alerts

Creating an Alert

Go to Alerts in the sidebar → click + New Alert. Fill in:

  • Ticker — the stock symbol (e.g. AAPL)
  • Alert type — choose from 6 types (see below)
  • Target value — price $ or % depending on type (not required for Earnings/News)
  • Notify via — In-app, Email, SMS, or All channels
  • Note — optional personal label shown when the alert triggers

Alert Types

TypeTriggers whenValue required
Price above $Price ≥ your targetTarget price
Price below $Price ≤ your floorFloor price
% increasePrice up X% from creation time% amount
% decreasePrice down X% from creation time% amount
Earnings reminder2 days before earnings dateNone
News detectedMaterial news event for tickerNone
Core Features → Stock Screener

Stock Screener

The screener lets you filter a curated list of stocks across 6 dimensions and view AI-powered recommendations based on your current portfolio gaps.

Available Filters

FilterTypeNotes
SectorDropdown8 sectors available
Min PriceNumberFilters out sub-penny stocks
Max PriceNumberLeave empty for no ceiling
Max P/ENumberLeave empty to include all
Min Div Yield %Number0 includes all stocks
SignalDropdownStrong Buy, Hold, Sell, Value, Growth, Income
SearchTextSearches ticker symbol and company name

AI Recommendations

The green strip at the top of the screener shows 3 stocks the AI recommends for your specific portfolio. Recommendations are based on:

  • Sectors underweight vs target allocation
  • Dividend yield gap (if income is a goal)
  • Beta imbalance (portfolio too high/low vs market)
  • Positions with strong analyst consensus

Click ↻ Refresh to cycle through three different recommendation sets.

Core Features → Tax Harvesting

Tax Harvesting

Disclaimer: Tax calculations are estimates based on a 15% long-term capital gains rate. Always consult a qualified tax advisor before transacting.

How It Works

Go to Tax Harvesting in the sidebar. The panel shows:

  • Unrealized Gains — total paper gains across all winning positions
  • Unrealized Losses — total paper losses across all losing positions
  • Est. Tax Liability — Gains × 15% (long-term rate)
  • Harvest Opportunities — each losing position as an actionable card

Harvesting a Position

Each harvest card shows:

  • Ticker and current loss amount
  • Estimated tax savings if harvested (Loss × 15%)
  • A Harvest button that queues a sell order

After harvesting, you can replace the position with a similar (but not substantially identical) ETF or stock to maintain market exposure while locking in the tax loss.

Core Features → Trade Journal

Trade Journal

Logging a Trade

Go to Journal in the sidebar. Click any day on the calendar to open the trade editor. For stock trades:

  • Select Shares mode (default)
  • Enter ticker, direction (Long/Short), entry price, exit price, and share count
  • P&L preview shows immediately: (Exit − Entry) × Shares

For options trades, click Options mode:

  • Select Call or Put
  • Enter strike price, expiry date, premium in, premium out, and contract count
  • P&L: (Premium Out − Premium In) × Contracts × 100

Monthly Statistics

The stats bar at the bottom of the journal auto-calculates for the visible month: total P&L, win rate %, win/loss count, trading days, total trades, and best day.

Plans & Billing → How to Upgrade

How to Upgrade

Click Billing in the sidebar → select your plan → click Upgrade. You'll be taken to Stripe's secure checkout. Upgrades take effect immediately.

Annual discount: Choose annual billing and get two months free — Pro Trader is $150/yr ($12.50/month), Elite is $250/yr ($20.83/month).
Plans & Billing → Cancellation

Cancellation

Cancel any time from Billing in the sidebar → click Cancel Subscription. You retain Pro access until the end of your current billing period. Your data is preserved — downgrade to Free, not deletion.

AI Risk Score Engine v2 + Screener AI

NewImprovedFix
  • Rebuilt risk score engine — now computes from 6 real metrics: HHI, weighted beta, losing position weight, sector diversity, position count, and win rate

Privacy Policy

Phantom Traders LLC ("Phantom Traders", "we", "us", or "our"), a Texas limited liability company headquartered in Dallas, Texas, is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use the platform.

By creating an account or using the Service you agree to this Privacy Policy.

1. Information We Collect ▾

Account data: Name, email address, password. Phone number is optional and only required if you enable SMS alerts (Elite plan).

Payment data: Processed entirely by Stripe. We never store card numbers or banking credentials.

Portfolio data you enter: Tickers, share counts, cost basis, trade journal entries, watchlist tickers, and alert configurations. This data belongs to you.

Usage analytics: Page views and feature interactions collected via Plausible.io — no cookies, no personal data, no cross-site tracking.

Brokerage data (Elite plan only): If you connect a brokerage via Plaid, Plaid handles authentication. We receive read-only holdings data only. We never store brokerage login credentials.

2. How We Use Your Information ▾
  • To operate and improve the Phantom Traders platform
  • To compute portfolio analytics, risk scores, and AI insights
  • To deliver price alerts as you configure (in-app, email, SMS)
  • To process billing and issue receipts
  • To respond to support requests
  • To send product emails and the weekly newsletter (opt-in only, unsubscribe any time)
  • To detect and prevent fraud, abuse, and security incidents

We do not use your portfolio data to train AI models sold to third parties or to make investment decisions for other users.

3. Data Sharing & Sub-processors ▾

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We share data only with these sub-processors, each under a data processing agreement:

  • Stripe — payment processing (PCI-DSS Level 1)
  • Supabase — database and authentication (US-East-1 / AWS)
  • Twilio — SMS alert delivery (only if you enable SMS)
  • Resend — transactional email
  • Plaid — brokerage connection (Elite plan only)

We may disclose information when required by law or to protect the rights and safety of Phantom Traders, our users, or the public.

4. Data Security ▾

We implement AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, row-level database security, and bcrypt password hashing (work factor 12). Production access requires MFA and is restricted to two engineers.

No transmission method is 100% secure. We will notify affected users of confirmed breaches within 72 hours as required by applicable law.

5. Data Retention ▾

Account data is retained while your account is active. Upon account deletion, personal data is purged within 30 days. Billing records are retained for 7 years for tax compliance. Portfolio data and trade journal entries are deleted immediately upon account deletion.

6. Your Rights ▾

You may request access to, correction of, export of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by emailing privacy@phantomtraders.com. We will respond within 30 days. California residents have additional rights under the CCPA.

7. Children and Policy Changes ▾

The Service is not directed to users under 18. We do not knowingly collect data from minors and will delete such data promptly if discovered.

Material changes to this policy will be communicated by email at least 14 days before taking effect. Continued use constitutes acceptance.

Privacy Contact

Phantom Traders LLC  •  Dallas, Texas, United States

Terms of Service

These Terms of Service govern your use of the Phantom Traders platform operated by Phantom Traders LLC, a Texas limited liability company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. By creating an account you agree to these Terms.

1. Not Financial Advice ▾

Nothing on the Phantom Traders platform constitutes financial, investment, legal, or tax advice. All analytics, risk scores, AI insights, screener results, and educational content are for informational purposes only and do not constitute a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold any security.

Trading involves significant risk of loss, including possible loss of the entire amount invested. Past performance is not indicative of future results. Consult a licensed financial advisor before making any investment decision.

2. Eligibility & Accounts ▾
  • You must be at least 18 years of age
  • You must provide accurate registration information
  • You are responsible for all activity under your account
  • You may not share accounts or create multiple accounts
3. Acceptable Use ▾

You agree not to: violate any applicable laws; reverse-engineer, scrape, or copy the platform; use bots or automated tools without written consent; introduce malware or harmful code; attempt unauthorized access to our systems or other users' accounts.

4. Subscriptions & Billing ▾

Paid plans are billed in advance monthly or annually via Stripe. All fees are in USD.

  • Cancel any time — access continues through the end of the billing period
  • Annual plans cancelled within 14 days may receive a prorated refund at our discretion
  • Pricing changes require 30 days written notice to your registered email
  • Failed payments may result in service downgrade after notice
5. Intellectual Property ▾

The Phantom Traders platform, including all software, design, and content, is owned by Phantom Traders LLC. You receive a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable license for personal, non-commercial use.

Your portfolio data and journal entries remain your property. You grant us a limited license to process that data solely to provide the Service.

6. Limitation of Liability ▾

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Phantom Traders LLC is not liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, including investment losses or loss of data. Our total liability for any claim shall not exceed fees paid by you in the preceding 12 months.

7. Termination ▾

We may suspend or terminate your account for violation of these Terms. You may delete your account at any time from Profile settings. Upon termination, access to the Service ceases immediately.

8. Governing Law & Disputes ▾

These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Texas, United States. Disputes shall be resolved by binding individual arbitration administered by JAMS in Dallas, Texas. Class action lawsuits and class-wide arbitration are waived.

Security

Security is foundational to how we build Phantom Traders. Here is a transparent overview of the measures protecting your account and data.

🔐

Encryption

AES-256 at rest. TLS 1.3 in transit. Application-layer encryption on sensitive database columns.

🛡️

Authentication

Bcrypt hashing (factor 12). TOTP two-factor auth. Session tokens rotate on every login.

📋

Access Control

Row-level security on all tables. Full audit trail for admin access. Production restricted to 2 engineers with MFA.

🔍

Security Reviews

Quarterly third-party pen tests. Dependency scanning on every commit. CVEs patched within 24 hours.

Responsible Disclosure ▾

If you discover a vulnerability, please report it to security@phantomtraders.com with a description, reproduction steps, and potential impact. We will acknowledge within 24 hours and respond within 72 hours. We do not pursue legal action against researchers acting in good faith.

Security Contact

security@phantomtraders.com

Phantom Traders uses a minimal number of cookies strictly necessary to operate the platform. We do not use advertising cookies, retargeting pixels, or third-party tracking of any kind.

What We Do NOT Use ▾

  • No Google Analytics, Google Ads, or DoubleClick
